steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Phew, what a "timely" support. Why did you contact us earlier? Then we wouldn't have to suffer so much.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Syndicate is in constant turmoil, so its communication network isn't secure. Forcing it might expose us.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Besides, Chief ${PlayerName} has always been excellent on the field.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: But I believe the intel has been leaked.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: It's still manageable. The Bureau is getting intelligence officers to spread decoys to divert those who are targeting you as soon as possible.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The support mission has been completed. Calls will be temporarily disabled until we identify the source of the leak and guarantee that intelligence is secured.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, the support may be limited, but the Bureau has always got your back.
